generator.never_a_runtime_dependency: Development-time reference. CONVENTIONS section 11: never regenerate a fixture from Rust output.
generator.description: Delta-T, UT1 and calendar reference values for skyfix_core::{deltat, time, calendar}.
generator.model: delta_t_s: Skyfield 1.55's build_delta_t (the Table-S15.2020 splines, the long-term parabola -320 + 32.5 ((y - 1825)/100)^2 s and its 800-year joins) run on SkyFix's weekly IERS table interpolated to whole days. skyfield_builtin_s: Skyfield 1.55's own timescale (its bundled table ends 2027-01-23 and is a prediction after about 2026-01-23).

sigma_rules.smh2016: max(SMH's published error, linearly interpolated between its change points, 0.11 s: the measured rms of the S15 spline against IERS over 1973-2019)
sigma_rules.before_-720: max(180 s, Huber(N)) with N = -500 - year (NASA's calibration year for dates before 500 BC)
sigma_rules.corrected_span: sqrt(0.001^2 + M^2 s (1 - s)), M the 0.105 s miss, s the fraction of the span
sigma_rules.after_last_observation: max(0.001 s, 0.00025 n^0.75 s (IERS Bulletin A), Huber(n / 365.25)) with n days since the last observed value
sigma_rules.huber: sigma = 365.25 N sqrt((N Q / 3)(1 + N / M)) / 1000 s, Q = 0.058 ms^2/yr, M = 2500 yr (Huber 2000, as quoted on NASA's Delta-T uncertainty page)
